race.description: Coastwide Waterproofing Supplies Provincial Mdn Plate
race.comment: CRASH BANG WALLOP (2) Deep Field mare from the good producer Thud on debut for the Widdup yard. Has shown enough in her three trials this prep to suggest she will take catching from the good gate. Go close. PARTHENON (7) Magna Grecia gelding from Kenyan Gold on debut for the Kylie Gavenlock stable. Has looked sharp in both his trials here and gets in light with Chambers' claim. Leading contender. STAR OF INDIGO (6) closed strongly in the heavy (9) going first-up with an unlucky second over 1000m at this track. Winkers go on for this and has to deal with a wide gate here. Each way. STREET LYRIC (13) resumes. Found a fairly strong race on debut when fifth over 1000m at Muswellbrook last March. Scored a slick trial win over 800m and maps well.
